standard_prerequisites.name: The Chern class expression for an effective Cartier divisor
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-support-cap-effective-Cartier, invoked at proof line 5634
standard_prerequisites.use: Deduces the second formula from the first by expressing the cap with the first Chern class through the pushforward along the divisor.

core_obligations: Reduce to an integral class: take an integral closed subscheme of the target of the relevant dimension and show that the intersection of the divisor with its preimage is an effective Cartier divisor (proof lines 5617-5621).

Compute the Gysin pullback: the easy Gysin statement gives that the Gysin pullback of the class of the preimage is the class of the intersection, which is the preimage of the subscheme under the restriction of the morphism to the divisor, and summing over a general cycle gives the first formula (proof lines 5621-5633).
Deduce the second: apply the expression of the cap with a first Chern class as the pushforward of the Gysin pullback (proof lines 5633-5634).
proof_roadmap: Integral class and the Cartier property (proof lines 5617-5621).
Easy Gysin computation and summation (proof lines 5621-5633).
Second formula from the first (proof lines 5633-5634).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Gysin pullback of a flat pullback along the restriction of the morphism to a relative effective Cartier divisor, and deduces the corresponding expression for the cap with the first Chern class (statement lines 5597-5615, tag 02TR-adjacent). The proof reduces to an integral class, uses the relative Cartier property and the easy Gysin computation to identify the two classes as cycles, sums over a general cycle, and then deduces the second formula from the first. The reduction and the summation are the substance, so the claim is H2.
